answer: Bindings are kept in mirror, verified in orchard, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the grove check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 214 aliases cost 247 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
